lines.trans: Senya, have you seen my hat today?
If you want to find the hat, follow the clues.
The first clue will perk you up early in the morning.
Okay, we need diapers, baby powder, and a car seat.
Vika, is it not too early to buy a seat?
Alright, do not worry, I will buy everything today.
Kostya, how much money goes into supporting a child?
Honestly speaking, absolutely everything goes to the child.
And how do I support a daughter on a cook's salary?
Well, that depends on what exactly you cook.
I urgently need to earn more money.
Then think about how to get a raise.

examples.trans: Look what kind of car they gave me recently.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'what, that', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Значит, тебе нужно там что-то менять.
examples.trans: Then you need to change something there.

examples.text: Баринова, что ли? Он мне даром не нужен.
examples.trans: Barinov, you mean? I do not need him even for free.

examples.text: Ну, это смотря что именно варить.
examples.trans: Well, that depends on what exactly you cook.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'specifically', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Ну, это смотря что именно варить.
examples.trans: Well, that depends on what exactly you cook.

examples.text: Вот именно, официантов я штрафовать не могу.
examples.trans: Exactly, I cannot fine the waiters.

examples.text: Вот именно.
examples.trans: Exactly, quite right.

meanings.en: to boil, to cook, to brew
meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to boil, cook', paired with 'сварить'.

examples.text: Ну, это смотря что именно варить.
examples.trans: Well, that depends on what exactly you cook.

examples.text: Навещу своего старого боевого товарища.
examples.trans: I will visit my old comrade-in-arms.

examples.text: Товарищ шеф, попробуйте вот это блюдо.
examples.trans: Comrade Chef, taste this dish right here.

meanings.en: urgently, right away; predicative: it is urgent
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'рочно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Мне срочно нужно больше зарабатывать.
examples.trans: I urgently need to earn more money.

examples.text: Мне надо срочно с бумагами разобраться.
examples.trans: I urgently need to sort out some paperwork.

examples.text: Павел Юрьевич, это срочно!
examples.trans: Pavel Yuryevich, this is urgent!

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Значит, тебе нужно там что-то менять.
examples.trans: Then you need to change something there.

examples.text: Баринова, что ли? Он мне даром не нужен.
examples.trans: Barinov, you mean? I do not need him even for free.

examples.text: Если не нужен, может, назад его вернёшь?
examples.trans: If you do not need him, maybe you will give him back?

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Можешь сейчас приехать за мной на рынок?
examples.trans: Can you come pick me up at the market right now?

examples.text: Мы сделали много.
examples.trans: We've done a lot.

examples.text: Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: Too much to do.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'рабатывать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to earn'.

examples.text: Мне срочно нужно больше зарабатывать.
examples.trans: I urgently need to earn more money.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и зарабатывать вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and to earn on time.

meanings.en: to think it over, to give it a thought
meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'умать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'think', paired with 'думать'.

examples.text: Тогда подумай, как получить прибавку.
examples.trans: Then think about how to get a raise.

examples.text: Витя, хорошо подумай про звезду Мишлен.
examples.trans: Vitya, think carefully about the Michelin star.

examples.text: Я подумаю.
examples.trans: I'll think about it.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'лучить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to get, to receive', paired with 'получать'.

examples.text: Тогда подумай, как получить прибавку.
examples.trans: Then think about how to get a raise.

examples.text: У тебя будет шанс получить звезду Мишлен!
examples.trans: You will have a chance to get a Michelin star!

examples.text: Кто получит деньги?
examples.trans: Who will get the money?

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'бавка'). Common feminine noun meaning 'pay raise' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Тогда подумай, как получить прибавку.
examples.trans: Then think about how to get a raise.

examples.text: На кухне отеля всегда есть прибавка.
examples.trans: In the hotel kitchen there is always pay raise.
